title: 汉字字谜探针数据集 / Chinese Character Riddle Probes Dataset (CCRP DataSet) v0.1
description: A 100-character Chinese character riddle dataset for behavioural structural probing of large language models. Contains 1,019 CC-Riddle-derived reference riddles with character-structure cards, 600 model-authored riddles with quality-control verdicts, a 597-item generation-solving closed loop (cross-model blind test and same-item self-test), a 2x2 factorial decomposition, and a 24-item ICL control task (192 API calls). Includes the accompanying paper in Chinese and English. This is a diagnostic probe, NOT a ranking benchmark: the off-the-shelf 100-item public slice has no ranking validity. 31 web-sourced clues of unspecified license are withheld from this public package (fingerprint-only ledger). Data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; scripts: MIT; paper and docs: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Upstream corpus: Fan Xu, Yunxiang Zhang, Xiaojun Wan, CC-Riddle: A Question Answering Dataset of Chinese Character Riddles, arXiv:2206.13778, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. We selected, reorganized and augmented it (attribution and modification notice: THIRD_PARTY.md). 31 web UGC clues are withheld under Scheme C; see data/WITHHELD.md. This is a diagnostic probe and must not be used for cross-model ability rankings.
